title: 1811 Prairie's roof loses the gash at its north-west corner
items: Seen from the north-west, the tall hipped roof at 1811 Prairie had a deep slot cut into it over the low corner pier, running back 3.4 m with a sheer slate wall.
The cut over the pier now tapers to nothing at the north eave, so the hip comes down to the pier in one piece.
From the street the pier still has open sky over its cap, as in the 1888 plate and both photographs.
